name: The Unclocked — BCI Refuser Collective
description: The Unclocked are voluntary BCI non-adopters who believe direct neural interfacing erodes authentic cognition and emotional sovereignty. Members wear a distinctive horizontal scar-brand above the right ear — the 'clean line' — marking the spot where no port was ever installed. Their weekly analog salons in Tier 2's Pilsen-Corridor warehouses involve handwritten correspondence circles, unrecorded conversation, and a strict no-device zone enforced by signal-dampening curtains called 'the veil.' Internal hierarchy splits between the Softwalkers (who use basic tech but refuse BCI) and the Hardline Unclocked who reject all networked devices entirely.
cultural_impact: Unclocked membership has become a quiet status marker in Tier 3 professional circles, where 'going clean' signals authenticity over corporate efficiency — though corponations track membership lists as potential productivity liabilities.
locations: The Paper Salon, Tier 2 Lakeview Overflow
story_hooks: A Hardline Unclocked member is found dead with a freshly installed BCI port — no surgery scars, as if it grew there overnight.
A corponation offers the Unclocked a deal: legal protected status in exchange for endorsing a 'voluntary' BCI opt-out program that secretly still harvests passive neural data.
A player character is approached by a Softwalker who has evidence of a corporate crime stored only in handwritten notes — and no way to digitize it without destroying the Unclocked's trust in her.
